certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Zero-trust / Moving-target-defense secure remote access for ICS/OT systems
certifiedServices.serviceName: Dispel Zero Trust Engine (DZTE) For Government

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: DZTE is a Government-only cloud computing SaaS that provides secure remote access to critical systems, enabling customers to implement compensating controls for operational technology and legacy technology environments.
serviceIdentification.serviceName: Dispel Zero Trust Engine (DZTE) For Government

secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: To request access to the DZTE Secure Configuration Guide, contact security@dispel-federal.com. Access is provided to FedRAMP reviewers and authorized U.S. Government customers.

certified.useCase: FedRAMP-authorized IaaS providing the compute, storage, and networking that hosts the DZTE service within the U.S. Government-only AWS GovCloud region.

FedRAMP-authorized SIEM/SOAR platform providing security information and event management (SIEM) and security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) for continuous security monitoring of the DZTE service.
Corporate identity, email, and collaboration services supporting Dispel personnel who operate and administer the DZTE service.
FedRAMP-authorized Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) providing continuous threat monitoring and response for the DZTE service infrastructure and administrative endpoints.
